gloss: several kinds; several types; a few varieties

definitions.gloss: several kinds; several types; a few varieties
definitions.explanation: An indefinite small number of distinct categories, typically two to nine. Combines {数|すう} (several) with {種類|しゅるい} (kind, type). Used adverbially with の to modify a noun.

examples.japanese: {数種類|すうしゅるい}のお{茶|ちゃ}を{試|ため}した。
examples.english: I tried several kinds of tea.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}では{数種類|すうしゅるい}のパンを{毎日|まいにち}{焼|や}いている。
examples.english: This shop bakes several kinds of bread every day.

examples.japanese: {症状|しょうじょう}に{応|おう}じて{数種類|すうしゅるい}の{薬|くすり}を{組|く}み{合|あ}わせて{処方|しょほう}する。
examples.english: Depending on the symptoms, we prescribe several types of medicine in combination.

notes:
The prefix {数|すう} attaches to counters to mean "several" — vague but small (typically 2–9). Almost always used attributively as {数種類|すうしゅるい}の + noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数種類|すうしゅるい}ある: there are several kinds
- {数種類|すうしゅるい}の{中|なか}から{選|えら}ぶ: to choose from several types
- {数種類|すうしゅるい}を{試|ため}す: to try several varieties

RELATED WORDS:
- {数人|すうにん}: several people
- {数日|すうじつ}: several days
- {数回|すうかい}: several times
- {数十|すうじゅう}: several tens (20–90)
